targets.label: Profile
targets.blurb: Your display name, avatar, secondary email, timezone, and language.

targets.label: Security & two-factor
targets.blurb: Enroll TOTP two-factor authentication for your own account.

targets.label: Sessions & activity
targets.blurb: Where you are signed in, and your recent account activity.

targets.label: Appearance & customization
targets.blurb: Your theme, saved views, and (admin) terminology + org defaults.

targets.label: Data scope
targets.blurb: Index pattern, entity fields, severity threshold, and polling.

targets.label: Models
targets.blurb: The model used for each agent role.

targets.label: Detection
targets.blurb: Clustering, risk weights, escalation, auto-close, and cross-source correlation.

targets.label: Detection & rules
targets.blurb: Author detection rules (match/threshold, anomaly) and case-automation rules in one place.

targets.label: Cases
targets.blurb: Human-facing case-ID nomenclature and live preview.

targets.label: SLA, priority & suppression
targets.blurb: Advisory SLA targets and the impact × urgency priority matrix, plus operator suppression rules that drop known-benign events before triage.

targets.label: Automation
targets.blurb: The master switch for threshold automation — rules that react to a case after the deterministic decision (authored in Detection & rules).

targets.label: Standup
targets.blurb: The daily aggregate summary window and cadence.

targets.label: Alerting & notifications
targets.blurb: Outbound channels, triggers, dedup, and digests.

targets.label: Enrichment
targets.blurb: Threat-intel lookups (AbuseIPDB / VirusTotal / GeoIP), cached in Redis.

targets.label: Knowledge & threat context
targets.blurb: RAG retrieval, the threat-context panel, MITRE, and runbooks/playbooks.

targets.label: Users
targets.blurb: Add accounts, assign roles, reset passwords, and enable/disable users.

targets.label: Roles & permissions
targets.blurb: Custom roles, the permission matrix, inheritance, and explicit denies.

targets.label: Single sign-on & policy
targets.blurb: Single sign-on (OIDC) providers and the token / session policy.

targets.label: Active sessions
targets.blurb: Review and force-terminate sessions across all accounts.

targets.label: Secret keys
targets.blurb: Write-only API keys for Elasticsearch, LLMs, and enrichment.

targets.label: Branding
targets.blurb: Org wordmark, logo, accent colours, and default theme.

targets.label: Updates & releases
targets.blurb: Public source repository, Stable/Testing refs, and read-only update discovery.

targets.label: Advanced
targets.blurb: Caps, kill switch, suppression rules, rule catalog, and the settings lock.

targets.label: All settings
targets.blurb: Every engine preference, generated from the backend schema — the long tail of knobs.

targets.label: Experimental & Demo
targets.blurb: Populate the console with isolated, $0, reversible synthetic data (experimental).

targets.label: Storage & retention
targets.blurb: Capability-aware Hot, Warm, and desired archive lifecycle for Agentic SOC-owned state.

targets.label: Data export
targets.blurb: Download a selectable, secret-free Agentic SOC analysis bundle.

targets.label: Danger zone
targets.blurb: Tiered reset of cases, sources, or the whole tenant. Never wipes env secrets.
